description: No spec subject (candidates: specled.append_only when picked up). Severity: Medium (calibrated down from spec auditor H1). From 2026-08-06 critical review of specled_-q0q. The self_authorized_weakening marker is emitted per (requirement, class) by the class-specific detectors; a requirement weakened via a path only one detector sees can surface differently depending on detector order. Keep-reason: unmade design decision — ticket q0q.2 simultaneously required uniform marker emission and forbade touching authorizing_decision/2, so a uniform-emission design (single choke point) needs its own decision + ADR. Concrete failure: a requirement weakened in class A while suppressed in class B can yield marker sets that depend on detector iteration order rather than a stated contract.
title: F1: self-auth marker emission is weakening-class/order-dependent — design decision needed
